Validations.Reason: The chapter explicitly describes Elias and Kaelen escaping the temple via a secret lower passage (the shaft under the altar) due to structural instability and the overwhelming nature of the entity. They are driven out by the creature after fighting off smaller channel creatures in the drainage system, matching the proposed summary and development.

The chapter confirms that the barrier functions as a trap designed to draw corruption in and consume it ('This was not simply a fortress... It was a trap built to draw corruption in and consume it'). It also reveals that smaller creatures inhabit the drainage channels and are awakened by Kaelen's blood, confirming the broader infestation.

The chapter establishes that the massive structure is feeding on the corruption consumed by the barrier ('It isn't resisting the Blight. It's feeding on it'). The text confirms the temple was built around a pre-existing containment system involving springs and lower passages, revealing the map of six smaller shrines and channels beneath the city.
